title: No mouth or organ: 560-million-year-old animal fossil found in Norwegian sheep field
description: It looked more like a plant than an animal; it had no visible way of moving, yet scientists believe Charnia was among the earliest animals to live on Earth

title: Ancient bones reveal that cannibalism took different forms in Neolithic Spain
description: Cannibalism was sometimes on the Neolithic menu, as numerous archaeological discoveries have revealed. But while ancient human bones show the practice took place, far less evidence exists about the forms it may have taken or why people occasionally consumed one another. Was it to stave off hunger during times of desperation? Did different tribes eat their defeated enemies? Or was cannibalism part of complex rituals?

title: Africa’s rocks hold ancient stories. We need better ways to document and protect them
description: Africa has some of the world’s most important geological landscapes, yet they remain under-represented in digital geoheritage research.

title: Scientists Found a 3-Meter Dinosaur Living Alongside an 8-Meter Giant on the Same Ancient Coast in Japan
description: For more than twenty years, a single dinosaur bone sat forgotten on a museum's own grounds. When scientists finally examined it, they uncovered something that changes the story of who really lived along Japan's prehistoric coast.

title: Deadly drugs, crime and kidnapping flagged at tourist hot spot known for ancient wonders
description: The U.S. State Department is flagging express kidnappings, violent crime and dangerous drugs like ayahuasca in an updated travel advisory for Americans considering trips to Peru.
